explanations.blur: Sets the radius, in processed-image pixels, used to detect local tonal variation for detail protection. Works with Preserve detail; does not directly blur the final image.
explanations.contrast: Adjusts the difference between light and dark before screening. Higher values separate tones more; lower values bring them closer together.
explanations.duotone: Maps tones between two colors: Shadow for the darkest and Highlight for the lightest. Intermediate tones blend both. Swap exchanges these colors.
explanations.pairs: Blends the 4×4 Bayer matrix with the 16×16 pair pattern of the Rosa technique. Higher values emphasize the pair signature within the tonal range defined by the profile. At 0, only the Bayer matrix remains.
explanations.protection: Reduces screening in areas with local tonal variation, helping preserve edges and textures. Higher values preserve more of the tonal base in these areas.
explanations.screen: Controls the blend between the tonal base and the dithered image. At 0, removes the dither pattern; at 1, applies full strength. Contrast, curve, and colors remain active.
